name: mission_register_multiplayer_maps
description: Mission::RegisterMultiplayerMaps initializes the multiplayer map-name CString table and registers its cleanup callback. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Functional smoke patches atexit, calls the CRT initializer wrapper, verifies all seven multiplayer map names and the registered cleanup callback, then destroys the constructed CString table.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c980 shows a direct call to NetSessionConfigDialog::InitMapNameStrings followed by a tail jump to NetSessionConfigDialog::RegisterMapNameCleanup.
The only data xref is the CRT initializer pointer g_CrtInitFn_MissionRegisterMultiplayerMaps at 0x4da048.
VC5SP3 byte verification passes for Mission::RegisterMultiplayerMaps under vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_afx_uintptr_win32ie_facs with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
